notes:
### Changed
- **Price panel rework.** A card's value is now a **Price variant** dropdown (one
  entry per printing) over a **Market / Low / Mid / High** grid — Market
  highlighted — with the estimated per-condition figures (NM/LP/MP/HP/DMG) as a
  row of small boxes instead of a text line, matching the CardTable layout.
- **Printing wording.** The base non-holo print of a card that had a first
  edition is now labelled **"Unlimited"** rather than "Normal", and 1st Edition
  and Unlimited are listed as separate variants when both are priced. Cards that
  never had a first edition keep "Normal".
- Settings text inputs (AI scanning key, scan-review token) get more vertical
  room so the text no longer sits against the box edge.

### Fixed
- TCGdex reuses one TCGplayer `productId` across a card's printings; rows are now
  only collapsed when their figures are identical, so the 1st Edition and
  Unlimited prices are no longer merged into one row (and the duplicate
  "Unlimited" + "Normal —" pair is gone).
- The **JP** badge now also appears on cards shown in Search, the scan "Change"
  picker, and the scan review candidates / matched card (previously only on sets
  and series).

### Notes
- No scan-index rebuild required: the descriptor, `SCAN_VERSION` and the card
  data are untouched; `DATA_VERSION` is unchanged.
